Name: Friendship Auto-Petter
Author: logNest
Description:
[b]Supported languages[/b]: English, 简体中文

[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Friendship Auto-Petter is a lighthearted mod that expands the original in-game Auto-Petter with a small friendship feature. When placed in the right location, the Auto-Petter can give eligible villagers and children a configurable friendship boost. 

You can interact with the Auto-Petter to check how it is working. The machine will show short reaction messages about the villagers or children affected by it. 

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
You can adjust the daily friendship boost through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or by manually editing config.json, and choose whether this feature applies to children.

[size=4][b]Advanced customization[/b][/size]
The built-in default location data covers the main vanilla resident locations.
After the mod runs once, edit `CustomLocationResidents.json` to override or add location mappings. This file only needs entries you want to customize:
[list]
[*]If a location already exists in the built-in defaults, its list replaces the default list.[/*]
[*]If a location is new, it is added.[/*]
[*]Use an empty list to disable a location.[/*]
[*]Remove a location from this file to use the built-in default for that location again.[/*]
[/list]For example:
[code]{
  "ScienceHouse": ["Robin", "Demetrius", "Maru"],
  "CustomNpcHouse": ["CustomNpc"],
  "Saloon": []
}[/code][size=4][b]Important notes[/b][/size]
[size=3]This mod does NOT add a new machine. It adds new features to the original Auto-Petter.[/size]
The Auto-Petter should be placed somewhere that does not block NPC walking paths.
[size=3]A character must be known to the player before the mod can increase their friendship. If a villager or child still appears as “???” or does not have friendship data yet, interact with them once first.[/size]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI. 
2. Unzip the mod folder. 
3. Place it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder. 
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.

[b]中文介绍[/b]
Joja公司（以及很多玩家）心想：“为什么自动抚摸机只能用在动物身上呢？”，于是就有了这个mod。
本mod是一个娱乐向mod，为原版的自动抚摸机扩展了一个小功能：把机器放在村民或自己家里，可以为对应地点的村民或孩子增加好感。
你可以和自动抚摸机互动，查看它的工作情况。机器会显示一些简短的文案，描述受影响的村民或孩子的反应。 

[b]配置[/b]
可通过 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] 或手动编辑 config.json 调整每日好感提升数值，并选择是否让该功能对孩子生效。
 
[b]高级自定义[/b]
mod 运行一次后，会自动生成 `CustomLocationResidents.json`。你可以编辑这个文件来覆盖默认的居民和地点映射，或添加其他模组新增的地点和 NPC。
这个文件只需要写你想修改的地点，不需要复制完整默认列表。规则如下：
[list]
[*]如果地点已经存在于内置默认数据中，这里的列表会替换默认居民列表。[/*]
[*]如果地点是新地点，这里的列表会新增为可用地点。[/*]
[*]如果地点对应空列表 `[]`，该地点会被禁用。[/*]
[*]如果想恢复某个地点的默认设置，把该地点从 `CustomLocationResidents.json` 中删除即可。[/*]
[/list]示例：
[code]{
  "ScienceHouse": ["Robin", "Demetrius", "Maru"],
  "CustomNpcHouse": ["CustomNpc"],
  "Saloon": []
}[/code][b]注意事项[/b]
本 mod 没有添加新机器，只是为原版自动抚摸机添加了新功能。
自动抚摸机需要避开NPC行动路径摆放。
NPC 必须先被玩家认识，mod 才能成功增加好感。如果某个村民或孩子仍然显示为“???”，或者还没有好感数据，需要先和他们互动一次。
